submitted.rationale: Index 12 (Al0.39Sb0.61) had the highest measured EQE, 0.00236%. That is about 4x index 10 (0.00057%) and 12x index 20 (0.00020%). XRD at indices 4, 8, 12 and 16 shows the same main pattern (strong peak at Q≈2.786, plus a peak at 4.54 that weakens with more Sb). So the change in merit most likely comes from composition within one phase, and the maximum lies on the Sb-rich side of 1:1, near index 12.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.00057%, about 4x lower than index 12
Measured EQE 0.00020%; the Sb-rich end performs poorly
Merit fell from index 12 to index 10, so it probably keeps falling toward the Al-rich end. XRD shows the same phase there, and Al2O3 cannot absorb 2.4 eV light.
